第五章 兵营夜战
“哧！”郭飞剑锋刁钻的窜出，瞬间将一个骷髅的颈部斩断。骷髅头滚到脚下，两只嘴巴一张一合朝郭飞的脚踝咬来。
郭飞一脚下去，骨头崩裂，里面滚出了两个指甲盖大小的晶块。
“魂晶，捡起来！”大汉提醒一声，将郭飞护在了阵型后面，郭飞趁机将其捡了起来。
顿时，一股冰冷的寒流侵入了肌肤，比外面的冰雪温度低了几十度，手上瞬间结了一层冰晶。郭飞体内热流一转，寒意消退。
“别用手捡，用布包裹着手，蠢蛋！”大汉一看，大环眼一瞪，声音如同破锣一样道。
郭飞一听，知道他们捡起此物的方法，于是用衣襟下摆包着，眼睛一闪，将这两块魂晶递给了大汉。
“这怎么好意思，这是你的战利品。”大汉看着魂晶，眼中放光道。
“刚才要不是大哥，我性命不保，权当一点心意吧！”郭飞执意的递了过去。
郭飞有自己的打算，总不能一辈子在奴兵营混日子，要想有门路，就要想办法，结交这些人，也是条门路，这点魂晶当“礼”送出去，未必会亏。看到大汉的眼光，郭飞知道这些魂晶不凡，能打动他们。
大汉使了个眼色，他身后一人接了过去，将其放在了专放这样物品的兽皮袋中。
此时，兵营的士兵在损失千人后，随着更多的士兵从迷糊中苏醒，加入了战斗，逐渐的将局面搬了回来。
毕竟，来的骷髅士兵不足两千，而一个营有万人，这些骷髅不是对手。
“杀！”营内士兵主动出击，喊杀声震天。
大汉所带的小队行动迅速异常，叫嚣着冲向骷髅兵。大汉异常的勇猛，一把大剑如同斧头一样的劈砍，看的郭飞暗自咋舌。
郭飞也不闲着，剑锋如风，一连斩杀了五个骷髅，效率比大汉带的小队还高。得到的魂晶全部给了大汉的小队。
“轰！”营寨门一声爆响，被撞开了。
“哧！”白影一闪，大汉队形中，接近门口的矮胖子被一杆长枪挑了起来，鲜血喷射而出，洒在了雪地上。
郭飞抬眼一看，顿时倒吸了一口冷气。在面前是个高大的骨马，骨马身躯由巨大的骨头组合而来，重要部位包裹着铁甲，装备着马鞍，两只空洞洞的眼中闪出两道暗红的光芒。脚下一团黑雾，如同漂浮在雪地上一样，看起来很是诡异。
在马背上端坐一名骑士，骑士笼罩在黑雾中，看不清真面目，只感到一股阴冷的煞气传来，几乎让人窒息。手中一杆一丈长的骨枪挑着矮胖子。身影缓缓的后退到营门口。

“老五！”大汉一声怒喝，就要冲上去。
“老大，莫冲动，他恐怕有鬼卫的实力！”大汉旁边一人紧紧的拉住了大汉。
随着一名鬼卫的出现，战斗顿时停止了一下，所有的骷髅迅速的后退，脱离了人族士兵的包围。
“好胆。你们鬼族竟然如此肆无忌惮，难道想挑起两族大战么！此事我们会向灵族禀报的，你们等着接受惩罚吧！”一声沉喝从营寨内传出，一身镶铜软甲的王志营长手握一把银白长剑，缓步走出来道。
“哈哈。北原人族，就会躲在姜氏一族的羽翼下苟延残喘。哼，灵族，过去了千年，不知道他们有真材实料，还是徒有其名，我们鬼王早就想领教一下。告诉你们领主，在一个月内准备一万名活人，十万钢剑、十万长枪。送到落日沙漠以北死亡雾海边，否则，我们自己来取，到时候就是你们赵国灭国的时候。”
黑雾遮蔽的骑士发出了阴测测的声音，让人听的毛骨悚然。他说完，骨马转头，带着一队骷髅缓慢的退去。
“营长，杀了他，为我五弟报仇呀！”大汉大喝一声，要冲出去。
“闭嘴！”营长旁边一人怒喝一声，冷然的看着大汉。
“营长大人，此时恐怕要迅速的报给给军团长，鬼族这次来者不善。”在营长后面一个文士模样的人低声道。
“连夜禀报将军，燃起狼烟预警！清理战场，救治伤员，加强戒备。”营长迅速的下达了几个命令。众人开始忙碌了起来。
郭飞一看，赶紧朝后面缩了缩，准备偷溜，毕竟自己是来偷食物的，倒霉的遇到这样的事情。
“唉！小兄弟，你不是奴兵营的打铁匠么！怎么会发现鬼族入侵的。”大汉手下一名队员顿时认出了郭飞，这些人经常去找他们修补兵器，自然熟稔。
“呵呵！”郭飞尴尬一下，指了指背后背的背包，那人会意的一笑，没有吭声。此时，郭飞的武技已经让他同等的看待郭飞了，这个世界是个强者为尊的世界，有这样的武技，谁敢小觑。偷点食物，这点小事，他们才不会管。
趁着夜色，在士兵忙碌的时候，郭飞悄然的溜出军营，返回了奴兵营的打铁铺中。
“发生了什么事！”老者一看郭飞带着一身的血腥回到了奴兵营，顿时惊诧的问道。
郭飞如实的将发生的事情说了一遍。
老者沉默半响叹口气道：“你我两人缘分已尽，恐怕要分离了。”
“文叔，这是为何？”郭飞一怔道。
“能和鬼族作战的，都是有等级的武者，你显露了武技，他们肯定不会让你在这里打铁了。你现在有中级武者的修为，这次鬼族来者不善，兵营缺人手，肯定拉你入伍。临走前，文叔没什么送你，给你打一把剑吧！”
“我！”郭飞刚想说。老者一摆手道：“年轻的时候就要去闯一闯，靠自己拼出个前程来，不要像我老头子一样龟缩在这里，当懦夫！你本不是奴隶，入兵营后就可以脱去奴兵身份，成为自由平民了。”

老者说完，似乎有勾起了伤心事，一下子苍老了很多，佝偻着身体走出去，在旁边的石屋中拿出了一段黝黑的钢铁。
“这是？”郭飞眼睛一闪，看着铁段道。
“这是玄铁。可能先前的铁匠不识货，也可能他们能力不足，锻造不了这样的精铁，留在了这里，便宜你了。呵呵！”老者露出了罕见的笑容。
“多谢文叔了！”郭飞早就想有一把剑，顿时喜上眉梢，诚恳的道谢道。
“别废话，生火锻铁！”
郭飞眉开眼笑，赶紧取来大量的木炭，将炉火烧的旺旺的。两人开始锻造。
（新书，求推荐、
content_en:
Chapter 5 Night Battle in the Barracks
"Chi!" Guo Fei's sword sharply shot out, instantly cutting off the neck of a skeleton. The skull rolled to its feet, and its two mouths opened and closed to bite Guo Fei's ankle.
Guo Fei kicked down, his bones cracked, and two crystal blocks the size of fingernails rolled out.
"Soul Crystal, pick it up!" the big man reminded, protecting Guo Fei behind the formation, and Guo Fei took the opportunity to pick it up.
Suddenly, an icy cold current invaded his skin. The temperature was dozens of degrees lower than the ice and snow outside, and a layer of ice crystals instantly formed on his hands. The heat in Guo Fei's body turned and the chill subsided.
"Don't pick it up with your hands, wrap your hands with cloth, you idiot!" The big man looked at it, his eyes widened, and he said in a voice like a broken gong.
When Guo Fei heard this, he knew how they picked up the object, so he wrapped it in the hem of his clothes and handed the two soul crystals to the big man with a flash of his eyes.
"How can you be so embarrassed? This is your trophy." The big man looked at the soul crystal and said with shining eyes.
"If it hadn't been for my brother just now, my life would have been in danger, so just show your kindness!" Guo Fei handed it over persistently.
Guo Fei has his own plans. He can't hang around in the slave barracks all his life. If he wants to have a way, he must find a way. Making friends with these people is also a way. If he gives this soul crystal as a "gift", he may not lose money. Seeing the big man's eyes, Guo Fei knew that these soul crystals were extraordinary and could impress them.
The big man winked, and someone behind him took it and put it in an animal skin bag specially designed for such items.
At this time, after losing thousands of soldiers in the barracks, more soldiers woke up from their stupor and joined the battle, gradually bringing the situation back.
After all, there were less than two thousand skeleton soldiers coming, and there were ten thousand people in a battalion. These skeletons were no match.
"Kill!" The soldiers in the camp took the initiative to attack and shouted loudly.
The team led by the big man moved very quickly and rushed towards the skeleton soldiers with a roar. The big man was unusually brave, slashing with a big sword like an axe, which made Guo Fei secretly speechless.
Guo Fei was not idle either. His sword was as sharp as the wind, and he killed five skeletons in a row, which was more efficient than the team led by the big man. All the soul crystals obtained were given to Dahan's team.
"Boom!" There was an explosion and the camp door was knocked open.
"Chi!" The white shadow flashed, and in the formation of big men, the short fat man approaching the door was picked up by a spear, and blood spurted out and sprinkled on the snow.
Guo Fei looked up and suddenly took a breath of air. In front of him is a tall bone horse. The body of the bone horse is composed of huge bones. Important parts are wrapped in iron armor and equipped with a saddle. Two dark red rays of light shine from its two hollow eyes. A group of black mist was floating under the feet, as if floating on the snow, which looked very strange.
There was a knight sitting on the horse. The knight was shrouded in black mist and couldn't see his true face. He could only feel a cold evil aura coming from him, which was almost suffocating. A ten-foot-long bone gun in his hand was holding the short fat man. The figure slowly retreated to the camp gate.
"Lao Wu!" The big man shouted angrily and was about to rush forward.
"Boss, don't be impulsive, he may have the strength of a ghost guard!" A person next to the big man held the big man tightly.
With the appearance of a ghost guard, the fighting suddenly stopped, and all the skeletons retreated quickly, breaking away from the human soldiers.
"How brave. You ghost tribe are so unscrupulous, do you want to provoke a war between the two tribes! We will report this matter to the spirit tribe, you just wait to accept the punishment!" A deep shout came from the camp, and Camp Commander Wang Zhi, who was dressed in copper-inlaid soft armor and held a silver-white sword in his hand, walked out slowly and said.
"Haha. The Beiyuan human race will hide under the wings of the Jiang clan and survive. Humph, the Spirit clan, after thousands of years, I don't know if they have real materials or just in name. We Ghost King have long wanted to learn from it. Tell your lords, prepare 10,000 living people, 100,000 steel swords, and 100,000 spears within a month. Send them to the sunset.To the north of the desert is the Death Fog Sea. Otherwise, we will take it ourselves, and then your Zhao country will be destroyed. "
The knight shrouded in black mist made an insidious sound, which made people's hair stand on end. After he finished speaking, the bone horse turned its head and slowly retreated with a group of skeletons.
"Batalion Commander, kill him and avenge my fifth brother! "The big man shouted and rushed out.
"Shut up! "A person next to the battalion commander shouted angrily and looked at the big man coldly.
"Battal Commander, I'm afraid I need to quickly report to the legion commander that the ghost tribe's visitor this time is not good. "A man who looked like a scribe behind the battalion commander whispered.
"Report to the general overnight and set off a smoke warning! Clear the battlefield, treat the wounded, and strengthen alert. "The battalion commander quickly issued a few orders. Everyone started to get busy.
When Guo Fei saw it, he quickly shrank back and prepared to sneak away. After all, he was here to steal food, and he was unlucky to encounter such a thing.
"Alas! Little brother, aren’t you a blacksmith from the slave camp? How did you discover the ghost invasion? "One of Dahan's team members immediately recognized Guo Fei. These people often go to them to repair their weapons, so they are naturally familiar with it.
"Haha! "Guo Fei was embarrassed and pointed to the backpack on his back. The man smiled knowingly and said nothing. At this time, Guo Fei's martial arts skills had already made him regard Guo Fei as an equal. This world is a world where the strong are respected. With such martial arts, who dares to look down upon them. They will not care about such a trivial matter as stealing some food.
Taking advantage of the darkness, while the soldiers were busy, Guo Fei quietly slipped out of the barracks and returned to the blacksmith shop in the slave barracks.
"What happened! "When the old man saw Guo Fei returning to the slave camp covered in blood, he asked in surprise.
Guo Fei truthfully told what happened.
The old man was silent for a while and sighed: "The fate between you and me has ended, and I'm afraid we will be separated. "
"Uncle Wen, why is this? "Guo Fei was startled and said.
"Those who can fight the ghosts are all high-level warriors. If you show your martial arts skills, they will definitely not let you forge here. You now have the cultivation level of an intermediate warrior. This time the ghosts are coming with bad intentions and the barracks is short of manpower, so they will definitely recruit you into the army. Before leaving, Uncle Wen has nothing to give you, but give you a sword! "
"I! "Guo Fei was about to say something. The old man waved his hand and said: "When you are young, you should go out and make a career on your own. Don't cower here like my old man and be a coward! You are not a slave. After entering the military camp, you can take off your status as a slave soldier and become a free civilian. "
After the old man finished speaking, he seemed to be aroused by something sad. He suddenly looked much older. He walked out with a stooped body and took out a piece of dark steel from the stone house next to him.
"Is this? "Guo Fei's eyes flashed and he looked at Tie Duan.
“This is Xuan Tie. Maybe the previous blacksmiths didn't know what they were doing, or maybe they weren't capable enough to forge such fine iron, so they stayed here and gave you an advantage. hehe! "The old man showed a rare smile.
"Thank you, Uncle Wen! "Guo Fei had long wanted to have a sword, and he was immediately overjoyed and thanked him sincerely.
“Stop talking nonsense, start a fire and forge iron! "
Guo Fei smiled happily and quickly fetched a large amount of charcoal to burn the stove vigorously. The two began to forge.
